integrity_notes: Proved by Eulerian realization and exhaustive symbolic flow/support classification; two standalone finite cross-check programs. The full 2012 expanded primary paper was inaccessible, so historical priority remains qualified. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three labeled letters, circular ordered-pair multisets, positive lengths and noiseless channels only; no enumeration of individual fibers, no general-alphabet formula. The ternary leading asymptotic constant is already known.
title: Exact ternary cyclic adjacent-pair profiles and the disconnected correction
